ops.title: launchd Load: keep its path free of bootout after a concurrent load
ops.description:
Owner: desk-roll-on-install implementation caller.
Review scope: staged diff; source inspection only; no tests run.
Severity: major
Evidence: plugins/long-running/lr/internal/launchd/launchd.go:160 — Load checks print and then delegates to Install, which checks again and can bootout at line 176. A concurrent installer can load desk-creds between checks with a different plist, causing Load to stop and restart it. Supervisor wiring runs before the lease is taken: supervisor/command.go:106 and :121.
Next executable step: Factor a bootstrap-only path for Load that never invokes bootout, including when another installer wins the race.

ops.text: An absent-to-loaded transition between Load checks cannot trigger bootout or kickstart.
An actually absent desk-creds job can still be bootstrapped.
